sentences.text:
Counsel for Applicant :- Sushil Kumar Pandey Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Ajay Bhanot,J.

By means of the bail application the applicant has prayed to be enlarged on bail in Case Crime No.
224 of 2023 at Police Station-Jamunapar, District-Mathura under Sections 323, 376, 452, 506 IPC.
The applicant is in jail since 21.07.2023.
The bail application of the applicant was rejected by the learned trial court on 11.08.2023.

The following arguments made by Shri Sushil Kumar Pandey, learned counsel on behalf of the applicant, which could not be satisfactorily refuted by Ms. Sujata Chaudhary, learned AGA from the record, entitle the applicant for grant of bail:
Manu vs State Of U.P. on 19 September, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/114572218/
1
1. The FIR arises out of a money dispute between the family of the victim and the applicant's father.
2. The prosecution case set out in the FIR and the statement of the victim under Section 161 CrPC do not make any allegation of commission of rape by the applicant.
3. False allegation of commission of rape was made subsequently after due deliberations only to save the failing prosecution case.
4. The criminal case is being leveraged in the money dispute.
5. Medical evidence to corroborate commission of rape by the applicant with the victim has not been produced by the prosecution.
6. Material contradictions in the FIR, the statements of the victim under Sections 161 and 164 Cr.P.C. discredit the prosecution case.
6. Prosecution evidence does not connect the applicant with the offence.
7. The records available with the learned A.G.A. disclose that the applicant does not have any criminal history apart from this case.
8. The applicant is not a flight risk.
The applicant being a law abiding citizen has always cooperated with the investigation and undertakes to join the trial proceedings.
There is no possibility of his influencing witnesses, tampering with the evidence or reoffending.
In the light of the preceding discussion and without making any observations on the merits of the case, the bail application is allowed.
Let the applicant-Manu be released on bail in the aforesaid case crime number, on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court below.

The following conditions be imposed in the interest of justice:-
(i) The applicant will not tamper with the evidence or influence any witness during the trial.
(ii) The applicant will appear before the trial court on the date fixed, unless personal presence is exempted.
Order Date :- 19.9.2023

Vandit  Manu vs State Of U.P. on 19 September, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/114572218/
